```python
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "store": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "C"],
    "revenue": [100, 150, 200, 250, 300],
    "items": [5, 7, 8, 10, 6]
})

df = nw.from_native(df)

result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    nw.col("items").mean()
)

print(result)
```
